🔓 Path traversal via unsanitized session_id LOW-MED

before (executor-route-nudge.ts:44-45)
function flagPath(sessionId) { return join(getSessionStorageDir(), `${sessionId}-executor-nudge.flag`); }
after
function flagPath(sessionId) { const safe = safeIdentifier(sessionId, 'invalid'); return join(getSessionStorageDir(), `${safe}-executor-nudge.flag`); }
try a session_id
The sanitizer already existed 100 lines away for the identical field: getSessionTempDir (paths.ts:157-159) was hardened against this exact class in incident #1826 (a leaked JSON envelope in session_id). This new hook just did not reach for it.

⏱️ TOCTOU race on the once-per-session guard

before
if (existsSync(flag)) return silent(); writeFileSync(flag, ts, 'utf-8'); // two concurrent calls can both // pass the check above
after
if (existsSync(flag)) return silent(); writeFileSync(flag, ts, { flag: 'wx' }); // 'wx' = create-exclusive, throws // EEXIST if a racer already wrote it
5 concurrent invocations, same session
before: up to 5 nudges could fire  →  after: exactly 1 fires, verified by test
Blast radius was always low (a duplicate advisory message, not corruption) . flagged and fixed anyway since the fix was one line.

🪞 Cross-session name collision in the audit script IRONIC

before (run-activation-audit.sh)
const nameToType = {} nameToType[agent_name] = type // session B's "reviewer" silently // overwrites session A's "reviewer"
after
const nameToType = {} nameToType[`${session_id}:: ${agent_name}`] = type // each session's mapping is // independent
two sessions, same custom name "reviewer"
before: session A's spawn misresolves to session B's agent type
after: both sessions resolve correctly, independently . verified by 2 new shell test cases
This is the exact shadowing shape #3129 was written to fix, reintroduced one level up inside the fix itself . the tool that exists to stop the audit from grading its own bad data had its own version of the bug.
